what: [live] The same defect that PR #14800 fixes for decision_bar: closed donchian legs (a frame served from the 300 s candle cache, or fetched a few seconds after a boundary, whose last row is a bar that is closed by the CLOCK but whose data was fetched before the close or before the venue finalised it) affects every other closed-bar consumer that calls src.runtime.closed_bars.drop_forming_bar on a fetch_candles frame: regime scoring (src/runtime/regime_bar_scoring.py, FIX-CA-23), the forecast producer (src/runtime/forecast_live.py) and exit-head shadow (exit_head_shadow.py). drop_forming_bar tests open_ts + tf > now (clock), not open_ts + tf > fetched_at. Population: live CANDLE_CACHE_TTL_MAX_S = 300 s (get-env issue #14797, 2026-09-30), so every >=15m frame can be up to 300 s old; observed once on trend_donchian_xrp_4h (12:01:30Z read close 1.5143, later 1.5161 for the same 08:00 bar; 1 of 3 post-merge closes). Not measured for the observe-only consumers. General fix proposed by the manager: fetch_candles stamps df.attrs['fetched_at'] and drop_forming_bar treats a bar as forming when open + tf > fetched_at (falling back to the clock when absent), instead of per-caller cache bypasses.
why_it_matters: Train/serve skew for the ML heads that read closed-bar features (they train on final bars, serve partial ones), and the same partial-bar entry risk for any future closed-bar leg.
